require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'download_headers'

class DownloadHeadersSecurityTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    assert_equal 'attachment; filename="report.txt"', DownloadHeaders.disposition('report.txt')
  end

  def test_security_keeps_one_header_line
    value = DownloadHeaders.disposition("report.txt\r\nSet-Cookie: session=x")
    refute_match(/[\r\n]/, value)
  end
end
